value.rationale: The exact coefficient resolves dimension-dependent entrywise robustness of bounded-positive-spectrum matrix powers and resolvents, with nontrivial transition from O(sqrt(n)) in degree two to O(n) for higher-degree terms. This is a useful, natural spectral-filter condition number distinct from the usual operator-norm stability; the exact constants identify worst-case geometry rather than just supplying loose estimates.
